name: Indeed.ca Job Application Starter (DOM-Only)
description: Opens Indeed.ca, clicks the first job, extracts the description, and clicks apply using direct DOM selectors.

open_indeed.description: Wake up Chrome, open Indeed.ca homepage, and wait for it to settle.

click_first_job.description: Use a direct DOM selector to click the first job listing.

click_apply_button.description: Find and click the apply button using a direct selector.
